input.welcomeLead: Start with your underlay. You pick the detection profile in step 3.
input.welcomeHint: After upload you go through Underlay and Preprocess to Detection.
input.bakeRotationHint: Optional. Bake the current rotation into the image so the scale lines follow the walls. Also happens automatically when you continue to Preprocess.
input.scaleAxisMismatch: Horizontal and vertical scale differ by {diff}. A scan has the same pixel density in both directions, so check both rulers — detection stays correct, but the FML would come out squashed.
input.underlayHint: Download the current image (crop/erase + rotation) as PNG. Edit locally and re-upload — then set rotation to 0° (already baked into the PNG). Scale is set per upload. Draw references in step 2 (Preprocess).
input.reuseUnderlayHintOk: Takes the selected floor’s original scan + scale lines (without crop). Available after confirming scale on that floor. Crop this floor again afterward.
input.reuseUnderlayHintBlocked: First confirm scale on a floor (before crop) so that floor can be used as source.

pdf.title: Choose PDF page
pdf.lead: Select the page to use as underlay.
pdf.passwordProtected: This PDF is password-protected. Export an unprotected version first.
pdf.loadFailed: Could not load PDF. Check that the file is valid.
pdf.convertFailed: Could not convert PDF to image.

errors.projectSourceExpired: Project source expired (blob URL). Confirm scale again on the first floor, or re-upload the scan.
errors.noProjectSource: No project source yet. First confirm scale on a floor (before crop) — then you can reuse it here.
errors.loadDrawingFirst: Load a PNG/JPG floor plan first.

preprocess.bwHint: Fixed B/W (default 150). Adaptive is on by default (Advanced). No grayscale to detection.
preprocess.preBinarizeCheck: Pre-binarize to B/W (do not keep gray)
preprocess.adaptiveHint: Adaptive uses local contrast. For heavy hatching: turn off or raise the kernel (21–31).
preprocess.negativeHint: Inverts the processed B/W plan as the last step (after cleanup).
preprocess.inkWallHint: Read-only B/W used during wall classification for ink comparison on white faces (Otsu reference). This is not the Preprocess B/W — tune that on that tab.

inkWallParams.holeFill: Hole-fill / thicken: scaled to wall thickness

refs.title: References
refs.hint: Tune B/W first, then draw reference boxes on the same image. Wall: 1–3 selections (link each to min/mid/max thickness; pipeline uses max-equivalent). Door/window: multiple. After a box, back to pan; click Wall/Door/Window again to continue. Escape or click the active button to stop drawing. Shift+click removes a box. Reference analysis: Debug sidebar → «Export reference analysis».
refs.ocrOffHint: OCR off: no auto-scan on Walls. Details later via Dev view.
refs.ocrOnHint: OCR on: auto-scan on Walls during detection; details via Dev view.
refs.noThicknessYet: No wall thickness yet — measured when finishing preprocess.
refs.wallThicknessHint: Dropdown = band (min/mid/max). Number = export cm (overrides project step 0). Pipeline scales to max-equivalent.
refs.wallThicknessCmOverride: Export thickness in cm (overrides project default)
refs.doorTemplateHint: Per reference: standard door or closet door. Double doors and windows are determined later by the algorithm.

ocrSettings.title: OCR
ocrSettings.disabledHint: OCR is off — enable it in step 2 (Preprocess).

preprocess.copyBwHint: Copies B/W tune only (and measured wall thickness if known) from the selected floor. Redraw reference boxes after crop — coordinates from another floor won’t match.

stamp.title: Wall stamp
stamp.hint: FML walls from another floor as a stamp on this B/W. Align on canvas (handles), erase, then bake → adaptive B/W + black Otsu-OR.
stamp.bakedHint: Stamp baked into B/W + Otsu. Stamp set: step 4 as vector + thickness (origin from placement).
stamp.bakedHintInject: Stamp baked. Stamp set injects {count} walls at step 4 (minus erase; donor cm and thickness).

stampErrors.noWallsInBands: No walls in the selected thickness bands.
stampErrors.noFmlWalls: No FML walls on the chosen floor.
stampErrors.underlayPadTooLarge: The stamp is too far outside the drawing to extend the underlay. Move the stamp closer to the scan.
stampErrors.underlayPadFailed: Could not extend the underlay for the stamp.

errors.noDonorPreprocess: No floor with preprocess to reuse.
errors.drawWallRef: Draw a reference box on a wall.
errors.measureThicknessFailed: Could not measure wall thickness in the reference box. Redraw over a clear wall.
errors.bwUnavailableForMeasure: Wall B/W not available for thickness measurement.

walls.thicknessMissing: No wall thickness — draw a reference box in step 1.
walls.inkStale: Toolbar ink changed: process ink — only affected faces are reclassified.

ocrOnWalls.title: OCR
ocrOnWalls.hint: Text highlights are active (not baked yet). Adjust confidence, clear, or bake to ink.

ocrHits.shiftClickHint: Shift+click a box on the canvas to remove it.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.hint: Solid: same faces as Walls, but faces under the Gaps wall mask (step 2, black) are set to exterior — floors and gaps stay colored. Faces larger than 3× the largest door/window reference face (head/interior, not outer rim) are also cleared. Classify Walls first. Detail mode (debug sidebar): carve Otsu-white only inside gaps-black.
gaps.needWalls: Classify walls on the Walls tab first.

doors.title: Doors
doors.hint: Stage 1 swing filter: reference-driven face candidates (non-outside seeds, shared-edge clustering, size band 40–120 cm and aspect ±5%).
doors.needWalls: Classify walls on the Walls tab first.
doors.noRef: No usable swing reference found. Draw a door reference with swing arc in step 1.
doors.stats: Active {stage}: {hypotheses} · stage1 total: {stage1} · accepted: {accepted} · rejected: {rejected} · single: {single} · clusters: {clusters} · refs: {refs} · seeds: {seeds}
doors.sizeBand: Wall-axis px band: {min}-{max} (depth from door reference)

windows.title: Windows
windows.hint: Stage 1 axel filter + Stage 2 door-arc reject + Stage 3 evidence filter (framing at axis ends, fallback top+bottom).
windows.needWalls: Classify walls on the Walls tab first.
windows.noRef: No usable window axel reference found. Draw a window reference with clear inner strips in step 1.
windows.stats: Active {stage}: {hypotheses} · stage1 total: {stage1} · stage2 accepted: {stage2Accepted} · doorframe: shared {share}, adjacent {adjacent}, directional {directional} · stage3 accepted: {stage3Accepted} (framing {framing}, strip-stack {stripStack}) · stage3 rejected: {stage3Rejected} · doorframes: {doorframes} · stage4 windows: {stage4Windows} · doorframes: {stage4Doorframes} · refs: {refs} · candidate faces: {candidates} · accepted: {accepted} · rejected: {rejected}

status.colorsReady: Colors ready — review faces and finish detection.
status.thicknessScaledFromBand: Max-equivalent {px}px (from {band} ref — max measure was lower)
status.profileChanged: Profile changed — regenerate detection per tab.
status.needReference: First measure a wall reference via Auto-classify.
status.needReferenceOrBox: First measure a wall reference via the box or Auto-classify.
status.classifyNotStarted: Wall classification did not start — check profile (Solid/Open) and try again.

errors.confirmScaleFirst: Confirm scale with ✓ before starting detection.
errors.pipelineNotLoaded: Detection pipeline not loaded (noop). Restart the app — worker must register geometry-lbe.
errors.finalizeFailed: Finishing detection failed — classification kept. Try again or reload the page.
errors.noBwForInk: No wall B/W available for processing ink.
errors.noTextFound: No text found — adjust confidence or mode.
errors.enableOcr: Enable OCR text detection to scan.

result.needScale: Confirm scale first to see the FML preview.
result.needFinalize: Finish wall detection for the FML preview.
result.clipboardUnavailable: Copy to clipboard is not available in this browser/context.
result.hidePlanTextAria: Hide room names and plan labels
result.bovenlichtTitle: 40 cm high, 10 cm above the door, same width. Only in FML export (not in preview). Overridable per door via Ctrl+click.
result.bovenlichtWindowsTitle: 40 cm high, 10 cm above the window, same width. Only in FML export (not in preview). Overridable per window via Ctrl+click.
result.openingOverflow: {kinds} extend above wall height ({top} cm vs {floor} cm). Not blocking — export continues; transoms that do not fit are skipped or shortened.
result.openingOverflowBelow: {n} openings extend below the wall bottom (sill {sill} cm vs bottom {floor} cm). Not blocking.
result.thicknessMinTitle: Export thickness for walls in the min band
result.thicknessMidTitle: Export thickness for walls in the mid band
result.thicknessMaxTitle: Export thickness for walls in the max band
result.pickMinTitle: Measure min band boundary on underlay (measured × 1.10)
result.pickMaxTitle: Measure max band boundary on underlay (measured × 0.90)
result.bandHint: Measure band: min < {mid} · mid {mid}–{max} · max > {max} cm
result.doorHeightTitle: Default for all doors; overridable per door via Ctrl+click in the preview
result.windowSillTitle: Default floor → bottom of window; overridable per window via Ctrl+click
result.windowGlassTitle: Default glass height; overridable per window via Ctrl+click in the preview
result.overrideHint: Override per opening: Ctrl+click in the preview → size/height.
result.sanitizeHint: Square near-90° corners and remove overlapping walls
result.rescaleHint: Place H/V rulers against walls (face snap) and confirm the true size
result.rescaleHelp: Drag the H and V rulers onto wall faces. Step 1 sizes are prefilled; H and V scale independently (wall thickness unchanged).
result.mirrorVerticalHint: Flip the floor left–right around the origin (0,0). Click again to undo.
result.mirrorProjectHint: Flip all floors left–right around each floor origin (0,0). Align origins first. Click again to undo.
result.rotate90CwHint: Rotate the floor 90° clockwise around the origin (0,0).
result.rotate90CcwHint: Rotate the floor 90° counter-clockwise around the origin (0,0).
result.underlayRotate90CwHint: Rotate the underlay image 90° clockwise (display only).
result.underlayRotate90CcwHint: Rotate the underlay image 90° counter-clockwise (display only).
result.underlayMoveHint: Toggle: drag to move the underlay; click again to lock. Walls stay put.
result.dirtyHint: Height/thickness changed — click Regenerate to update the preview.

thicknessPick.clickWall: Click a wall to set the {tier} measure band (±10%).
thicknessPick.retry: Click a wall again for the {tier} measure band.
thicknessPick.noUnderlay: Underlay missing — upload and confirm scale before measuring.
thicknessPick.noWallBw: Wall B/W missing — finish preprocess (step 2) before measuring bands.
thicknessPick.measureFailed: Measurement failed — wall B/W or wall unavailable.

toolbar.hintDefault: Choose selection tool · space + drag = pan · double-click + drag = slide (perpendicular to wall) · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Esc = deselect · corner = drag (snaps to other ends) · Ctrl+drag = without snap
toolbar.hintAreaSideDims: Room side lengths (≥ 50 cm) at the center of each wall · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintMeasure: Drag between 2 points · Shift = H/V · Ctrl = no snap · Esc = cancel · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintMeasureTape: Tape: temporary measure (not in FML) · Shift = H/V · Ctrl = no snap
toolbar.hintMeasureManual: Manual: permanent dimension · snaps to wall faces/axes (also outside) · Shift = H/V · Ctrl = no snap
toolbar.hintMeasureSlicer: Slicer: 1st = P (place), 2nd = M (measure) · H/V · Shift = free · pencil = edit
toolbar.hintMeasureSlicerEdit: Slicer edit: click dimension chain or drag M/P · H/V ±50 cm · Shift = free · pencil off = place
toolbar.hintNulpunt: Drag the cross to the alignment point · ✓ bake as FML (0,0) · ✕ / Esc cancel · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintDrawWall: Click start · move · click end or Accept · type length (m) + Enter · soft-snap to corners · Shift = horizontal/vertical · Esc = exit tool
toolbar.hintDrawRoom: Click start · move for orientation · click or Accept or type H/V (m) + Enter · soft-snap to corners · Shift = square · Esc = exit tool
toolbar.hintDrawSurface: Click corners of an overlay polygon · rubber-band follows cursor · snaps to other polygon corners/edges · H/V snap · Shift = horizontal/vertical · Ctrl = no snap · double-click / first point / Enter = close · Esc = cancel
toolbar.hintDrawLabel: Click to place a text label · set size/colour/style · Ctrl+click an existing label to edit · Esc = deselect
toolbar.hintDrawLine: Click start · move · click end or Accept · set style/thickness/colour · Shift = horizontal/vertical · Esc = exit tool
toolbar.hintLabelSelected: Edit text, size, colour and style · Delete removes the label
toolbar.hintLineSelected: Adjust style, thickness and colour · Delete removes the line
toolbar.hintAddDoor: Click a wall to place a door · choose type and size · Esc = exit tool · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintAddWindow: Click a wall to place a window · choose type, width, sill and glass height · Esc = exit tool · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintAddFixture: Choose an object, then tap to place · 2 fingers = pan · pinch = zoom
toolbar.hintBoxSelect: Drag box — walls fully inside selection · Shift/Ctrl+box = add · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Esc = deselect · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintAreaSelected: Room selected · set type, name and colour · Ctrl+click again to deselect · Esc = deselect
toolbar.hintSurfaceSelected: Surface selected · set type/name/colour · Edit polygon (snaps to other polygons + H/V, Shift = straighten edges, Ctrl = off) · Esc = deselect
toolbar.hintWallOne: 1 wall selected · adjust thickness/alignment/height · space + drag = pan · double-click + drag = slide (perpendicular) · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Ctrl+corner-drag = without snap
toolbar.hintWallMany: {count} walls selected · adjust thickness/alignment/height or delete the group · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintJunction: Junction selected · adjust height for all walls at this corner · Ctrl+click = deselect · Esc = deselect
toolbar.hintDoorOne: 1 door selected · adjust size/height/mirror · copy to place again · drag = move along wall · Ctrl+click = (de)select
toolbar.hintDoorMany: {count} doors selected · adjust settings or delete selection · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintWindowOne: 1 window selected · adjust width/sill/glass · copy to place again · drag = move along wall · Ctrl+click = (de)select
toolbar.hintWindowMany: {count} windows selected · adjust settings or delete selection · space + drag = pan
toolbar.alignmentTitle: Body vs centerline. Slider 0–100%; type values outside that range if needed.
toolbar.facadeGroupSelectTitle: Select all facade walls on this floor
toolbar.facadeGroupNameHint: Name for the new facade group
toolbar.stampGroupSelectTitle: Select all stamp walls on this floor
toolbar.bovenlichtTitle: FML export only, not in preview. Size follows the floor default unless overridden here.

toolbar.hingeAtEnd: Hinge: end — click to set to start
toolbar.swingRight: Swing: right — click to set left
toolbar.swingLeft: Swing: left — click to set right

settings.title: Default settings
settings.hint: Heights and wall thicknesses apply to new projects and “Reset to defaults” on step 0. Scale unit only affects typing on the scale rulers (step 1); calculations stay in mm. Opening merge and opacities apply on the FML page (step 4); open projects pick them up when you return from settings.
settings.hintViewer: Language, heights, wall thicknesses and room colours for the FML editor. Closing saves; Cancel discards changes.
settings.commitHint: Closing (gear) saves your changes. Cancel discards them.
settings.scaleUnitHint: Only for typing distances on the H/V scale rulers (converter step 1 and FML editor underlay scale). Internal calculation remains millimeters.
settings.bovenlichtGapTitle: Distance between top of door/window and bottom of transom (cm)
settings.bovenlichtHeightTitle: Glass height of the synthesized transom (cm)
settings.thicknessHint: FML output thicknesses (min/mid/max). Measure bands come from the wall reference.
settings.fmlConversionHint: Automatically merge adjacent detected singles into double doors or double/triple windows when generating FML. Manual add in the editor is always available.
settings.mergeDoubleDoors: Merge adjacent doors into double doors
settings.roomTagsHint: Default fill colour when tagging a room or surface. Existing tagged rooms keep their own colour until you change the type or colour on that item.
settings.roomTagResetAllTitle: Clear all colour overrides; catalogue factory colours apply again
settings.openingColorsHint: Colours in the FML preview. Selection (orange/blue) stays the same. Not written to the FML export.
settings.openingColorsResetAllTitle: Restore door, window and transom colours to the defaults
settings.cornerMarkersHint: Show |_ on exact 90° H/V inner corners, or ! on corners that are not square. T and X junctions get a mark in each inner corner.
settings.slicerOffsetSnapHint: Forbidden strip canvas-tall/wide vs other P’s (fixed spacing, default 50 cm). Same place line not allowed. P↔M stays free. Shift = off.
settings.parseNotObject: Settings file is not an object
